digest.component_or_area: completion-verification close gate / LLM agent runaway guard
propositions: The runaway guard counts memo-served (cached) file re-reads as loop evidence because the guard layer sits outside the memo layer in composition order, observing all calls before memo cache hits prevent actual execution.

Prior memoization fix (lever 2, epic 10ae/story 2948) made repeat file reads free but the guard still penalizes them, causing legitimate verifier evidence re-reads to incorrectly trigger RunawayToolLoopError and abort completion without forcing.

The recomposed guard uses a shared ToolCallLedger that tracks only EXECUTED (non-cached) calls for the distinct-ratio arm, while memo-served repeats extend a served-streak backstop that bounds pure cache-served loops.

Five specific execution record sites were added to the memo layer to notify the ledger: non-allowlisted passthrough, exact-signature cache miss, read_file with unparseable path, read_file first-read whole-file fetch, and uncached exact-range fallback for truncated windows.

The two-arm guard design (distinct-ratio over executed stream + served-streak backstop) preserves layer order (Guard→Memo→Steering) and completion-policy visibility while eliminating the conflict between memoization and runaway detection.
